description: This file defines the SendThingMessage class, a final immutable Java class representing a command to send a message to a specific 'Thing' in an Eclipse Ditto-based system. It includes static factory methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON input, and manages message payloads and headers.

classes.name: SendThingMessage
classes.description: A final immutable class representing a command to send a message to a specific Thing, with static factory methods for creation and JSON deserialization.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new SendThingMessage with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a SendThingMessage instance with a ThingId, Message, and DittoHeaders; deprecated version accepts String for ThingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SendThingMessage instance from a JSON string or JSON object, with specified DittoHeaders.
